scope: Prospective earliest-MoE-layer all64 expansion: Deep layer1 with dense0 unchanged, OLMoE layer0; all other functions source GGUF.

source_proof.statement: For the same complete token history, absolute positions, fresh initial state, batch/ubatch plan, backend/numerics and unchanged upstream functions, replacing only this layer's routed expert output cannot change that layer's Up input, selected expert IDs or final alpha.
source_proof.induction: Embedding and all lower-layer outputs/caches are unchanged. The earliest modified layer's attention keys/values derive from its upstream input, are written before its FFN and are private to that layer. By token-history induction, its attention/residual/FFN-normalized input remains identical. Its fixed deterministic router then yields identical IDs/alpha. Expert outputs and all later-layer states may differ.
source_proof.Deep_source: models/deepseek2.cpp:264,313,317,327/364 derive/store attention K/V before ffn_inp373, norm376 and MoE388; dense branch379 is unchanged at layer0. Shared FFN403 consumes the same pre-MoE cur, and next-layer input changes only at423.
source_proof.OLM_source: models/olmoe.cpp:74,82,85,88 compute attention Q/K/V from current upstream input; attention119 precedes residual127, FFN norm131 and MoE136.
source_proof.KV_source: llama-graph.cpp:2217-2218 stores k_cur/v_cur by layer; MLA2309 stores k_cur, whose V view derives from compressed attention state, not FFN output.
source_proof.no_crosslayer_recurrence: llama-model.cpp:2002 initializes layer reuse null; only Gemma3n/Gemma4 receive a reuse callback at2004. Deep/OLM KV construction does not reuse later-layer caches. llama-kv-cache.cpp:224 assigns separate layer storage.
source_proof.router_source: llama-graph.cpp:1383-1499 derives fixed top-k/normalized/scaled weights only from the same pre-FFN cur. Deep/OLM use post-FFN weighting,1668-1670, not Llama4 weight-before branch.

exact_reuse_limits: Existing TRAIN inputs are exact counterfactual replay inputs for their recorded full token histories and original chunking, not an on-policy distribution for new first64 free generation.

Old B/C/D generated token strings can differ because their downstream logits differ. If each string is replayed as fixed groundtruth with identical positions and batching, earliest-layer invariance holds for that string.
Previously proved B1/batch equality concerns canonical f_e(x) with fixed x. It does not certify native attention X remains bit-identical after rechunking an old trajectory.
New GT512 four-batch evaluation can prospectively check the three new arms against one another; it cannot call old128+8 or768+32 captures the same unseen validation states.
Free generation changes token histories and requires separate evaluation. Later-layer hidden states, routes, caches and logits are expected to differ even under shared GT.

Bit equality in a concrete runtime remains a prospective check: same X/IDs/alpha before/after first-layer expert replacement, fixed positions/batching/ISA, fresh independent contexts and no writes/aliases into attention or KV.
scope_and_provenance: A new explicitly versioned, prospectively frozen configuration with a fresh unopened held-out set need not violate the ban on retuning the old passed8 configuration.

Keep the old8 artifacts, geometry, maps, result and threshold immutable. Reuse earliest-layer old maps/geometry as declared; disabling late-layer interventions is a new version, not a reinterpretation of the old screen.
New124 operator targets, per-expert penalty/control roles, common data/query budget and stopping rules must be frozen before new held-out outcomes. No reuse of PG16 to select or tune the new maps.
The unchanged earliest-layer common input geometry makes reuse principled and avoids same-layer covariate feedback; it does not prove statistical representativeness or sample convergence.

value_and_strong_controls.role: A cheaper and cleaner whole-layer quality expansion, substantially broader than eight selected operators, but still not all-routed/full-model compression.
value_and_strong_controls.host_control: Both the local bank and original canonical single-layer coefficients are individually below1GiB before full runtime accounting. Give all-host/cache controls with the same total host/stack/KV budget; this isolated stage does not establish NAND necessity.
value_and_strong_controls.coefficient_fraction: For equal-sized routed projections and fixed K, replacing one layer addresses1/26 of Deep routed-layer coefficient work or1/16 of OLM. This is not a strict end-to-end latency bound; command/DAG/cache effects and shared/dense/attention costs still matter.
value_and_strong_controls.publication_limit: Passing first64 does not establish all-depth quality, capacity necessity, meaningful whole-model speed or new mechanism value. Matched global/nonlinear controls and the earlier system cost-window requirement remain.

disposition: No theoretical obstruction to the fixed-GT invariance argument under the stated conditions. No approval of a new experiment, target query, model run, source implementation or scientific round outcome.
reviewer_actions: Read pinned source and hashed only source files. No candidate data, model weights, activations, book payload or new outputs read; no code/probe execution.
